title: Order Fulfillment Event Platform — Architecture
subtitle: Pub/sub-heavy backend with multiple async workers and downstream consumers

items.title: Checkout App
descriptionLines: Customer checkout and order submission flow

items.title: Partner Integration Hub
descriptionLines: Resellers and fulfillment partners sending order events

rows.title: Event Catalog Control Plane
descriptionLines: Registers topics, schemas, and routing rules.

rows.title: AuthZ Policy Service
descriptionLines: Scopes, grants, and partner access policies.

rows.title: Order Intake Service
descriptionLines: Accepts placed orders and emits canonical order events.

rows.title: Event Router
descriptionLines: Fan-out, retries, and routing to downstream consumers.

rows.title: Projection Worker
descriptionLines: Builds read models and materialized views from streams.

rows.title: Notification Worker
descriptionLines: Batch fan-out for confirmations and follow-up messages.

rows.title: Order & Shipment Model
descriptionLines: Canonical order, shipment, and inventory state model.

items.title: Order Database
descriptionLines: Primary PostgreSQL store for order state and routing metadata

items.title: Event Archive
descriptionLines: Immutable stream retention and replay history

items.title: Message Bus
descriptionLines: Topic transport for order, payment, and shipment events

items.title: Warehouse API
descriptionLines: Stock reservation, pick, and pack updates

items.title: Shipping API
descriptionLines: Carrier handoff, label generation, and tracking
